purpose: Per-value detail for every populated Firm Drop Down at American Freight - for documenting how drop-downs behave.
status: COMPLETE. Names, LxBOIDs, Inactive, row actions and Available-for-Portfolios captured for all 73 populated tables (1140 values, 1140 with the portfolio attribute, 0 errors).
scope: 73 of 207 tables are populated at AF; the other 134 are empty. No people's names appear - these are code-table values only.
inactiveSemantics: Observed: `Inactive` is a per-value flag surfaced as its own grid column, separate from deletability. Across all 1140 AF values only ONE is Inactive=Yes, so at this tenant deactivation is essentially unused in practice - values are added and kept. 14 values sit in tables whose grid renders no Inactive column at all, so the attribute is not universal across code tables.

availableForPortfolios.source: Per-value view popup: GET /en/admin/FirmCodeEdit.jsp?popupEdit=true&formSubmit=viewBO&TableType={tt}&CodeID={id} - field `PortfolioIDList`, UI label 'Available for the following Portfolios'.
availableForPortfolios.finding: Observed on ALL 1140 values, no gaps: every single one has an EMPTY PortfolioIDList. Not one code-table value at American Freight is scoped to a subset of portfolios. The mechanism exists on every value's edit form and is entirely unused at this tenant.
availableForPortfolios.readingForTheRebuild: Derived. Portfolio-scoping of drop-down values is a real per-value capability in Lucernex (a multi-select of portfolios on each code value), so ASG Edge+ should know it exists - but AF gives zero evidence about how it BEHAVES when set, because it never is. Anyone specifying it needs a tenant that actually uses it, or the BBW equivalent, before assuming semantics.
